selected_evidence.requirement: CA certificate installed as trusted system CA

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof CA is trusted for TLS validation (pre-restart)
selected_evidence.summary: Issued leaf cert signed by CA, served via TLS, curl with system trust store validated chain: 'SSL certificate verify ok'
Captured baseline boot ID d4784d1b-162e-4faa-b581-f6427617d23c and confirmed CA trust anchor present before restart
systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent polls show connection timeout/reset confirming node went down
Node1 exec available again with new boot ID 45f1469e-e936-4160-9ce5-2ee5d3f06fb3, differing from baseline, proving actual restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart - post-restart recovery of CA trust and functional TLS validation
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart: trust list shows CA anchor still present, openssl verify OK, and curl again validated leaf cert TLS chain with 'SSL certificate verify ok', confirming full recovery

commands.command: mkdir -p /root/ca/{private,certs} && chmod 700 /root/ca/private && cd /root/ca && openssl genrsa -out private/ca.key.pem 4096 2>&1 && chmod 400 private/ca.key.pem && echo OK

cd /root/ca && openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key private/ca.key.pem -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA/O=OS Comparison" \
  -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" \
  -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" \
  -out certs/ca.cert.pem 2>&1 && chmod 444 certs/ca.cert.pem && echo OK

commands.stdout:

notAfter=Aug 31 12:10:00 2036 GMT

commands.command: trust list | grep -A1 "OS Comparison Root CA"; echo ---; openssl verify /root/ca/certs/ca.cert.pem; echo ---; awk -v cmd=1 '/OS Comparison Root CA/{print}' /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt | head -1; grep -c "OS Comparison Root CA" /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt
commands.stdout:
label: OS Comparison Root CA
    trust: anchor
---
/root/ca/certs/ca.cert.pem: OK
---
# OS Comparison Root CA
1

commands.command:
cd /root/ca && openssl genrsa -out leaf.key.pem 2048 2>&1 && openssl req -new -key leaf.key.pem -subj "/CN=test.oscomparison.local" -out leaf.csr.pem 2>&1 && openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr.pem -CA certs/ca.cert.pem -CAkey private/ca.key.pem -CAcreateserial -days 365 -sha256 \
  -extfile <(printf "subjectAltName=DNS:test.oscomparison.local
basicConstraints=CA:FALSE
keyUsage=digitalSignature,keyEncipherment
extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth") \
  -out leaf.cert.pem 2>&1 && echo OK
commands.stdout:
Certificate request self-signature ok
subject=CN=test.oscomparison.local
OK

commands.command: cd /root/ca && cat leaf.key.pem leaf.cert.pem > leaf.combined.pem && (openssl s_server -accept 8443 -cert leaf.combined.pem -key leaf.key.pem -www > /tmp/sserver.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/sserver.pid) && sleep 2 && echo started
curl -sv --resolve test.oscomparison.local:8443:127.0.0.1 https://test.oscomparison.local:8443/ -o /dev/null 2>&1 | grep -E "SSL certificate verify|subject:|issuer:|HTTP/"
commands.stdout:

< HTTP/1.0 200 ok
